tasks.short: Monitor food intake and weight and report actual changes

steps.what: Review the identified patient's existing food-intake and weight records and dietitian monitoring instructions
inputs: verified patient identity
care-team recorded intake and weight entries with dates, units and sources
dietitian-issued monitoring instructions
outputs: checked prior intake and weight context

steps.what: Observe and monitor actual patient food intake and obtain or verify actual body weight within the assigned monitoring work
inputs: checked prior intake and weight context
actual patient, meal intake and weight observation
outputs: actual intake and weight observations with dates and uncertainties

steps.what: Enter actual food-intake and body-weight observations, source, units and missing or uncertain values
inputs: actual intake and weight observations with dates and uncertainties
verified patient identity
outputs: complete draft actual intake and weight entries

steps.what: Assess and write actual changes, progress and dietary problems for the dietitian without inferring normality from missing data
inputs: complete draft actual intake and weight entries
checked prior intake and weight context
actual patient observations and dietary concerns
outputs: technician-written change, progress and dietary-problem findings

steps.what: Prepare the complete dietitian report from actual entries and technician-written findings with the intended dietitian recipient
inputs: complete draft actual intake and weight entries
technician-written change, progress and dietary-problem findings
assigned dietitian recipient from the care record
outputs: complete intake, weight and dietary-problem report packet

steps.what: Verify and approve the final actual entries, report and named dietitian recipient
inputs: complete intake, weight and dietary-problem report packet

steps.what: Save the approved monitoring entries and report as one patient monitoring record in the same care system
inputs: approved monitoring report packet v1

steps.what: Send the approved report to the assigned internal dietitian
inputs: approved monitoring report packet v1
stored actual patient monitoring record

tasks.design: Configure the {OPS_SYSTEM} patient monitoring view, dated observation form and fixed report layout. The technician obtains and enters actual observations, writes the meaningful changes and problems, then checks the assembled final report before separate storage and delivery to the dietitian.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reference navigation, form layout and report assembly can add work around actual patient observation and assessment.
tasks.enabler_now: Native dated fields and fixed report sections can reuse captured facts without interpreting dietary progress.
tasks.still_hard: Incomplete intake observations and variable weight measurement conditions require human interpretation and clarification.
tasks.human_edge: Notice a dietary problem that the numeric trend alone does not explain.

ambition.what: No additional clinical decision authority is assumed.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-6 for patient-data access and care-team consultation on recording changes

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: care systems can display dated observations and assemble fixed reports from actual structured entries and human-written findings.

assumptions: Boundary includes observation, actual record capture, assessment and reporting to the dietitian. Clinical programme decisions and dietitian review are other-role work outside the focal denominator and receive no saving.

Care-team existing entries include patient id, date, measure, unit and source; the dietitian supplies monitoring instructions. s2 obtains actual new observations and s3 retains fifteen hours for entry, uncertainty and correction. No device integration, transcript or free structured capture is assumed.
s4 explicitly writes change and problem findings before s5 assembles them verbatim with the observation table. Native configuration first; no model infers a problem or invents a missing measurement.
Shares and reductions are provisional scenarios, not measured baselines. No paper or rekey history is asserted. Same-system save and short internal send remain fully retained.
Approval binds this single patient's exact entries, report and recipient; any edit requires renewed approval. Urgent patient concerns follow existing human procedures and earn no saving here.
unknowns: Current native monitoring and report functionality
Actual form navigation and report assembly effort
research_questions: Can every reported value be traced to an actual dated observation and source?
Does the form preserve unknown intake rather than converting it to zero?

already_counted.description: Capture and check actual monitoring observations
Check fixed report assembly and patient identity

incremental.description: Maintain observation fields, report layout and dietitian-routing mappings

approvals.approved_version: approved monitoring report packet v1 with exact patient entries and report; edits void approval
approved monitoring report packet v1 including named dietitian recipient; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central gross 17.5 minus 1 upkeep gives 16.5. High allows 4.5 additional hours correcting uncertain observation references; low applies when native forms and reports already cover this work.

tasks.short: Assess dietary histories to help plan nutritional programmes

steps.what: Review the individual's existing dietary information and the supervising dietitian's assessment guidance
inputs: verified individual identity and existing dietary records
dietitian-issued assessment guidance and role boundary

steps.what: Obtain the individual's actual dietary history through questions, examples and clarification
inputs: checked dietary assessment context
actual individual account and available supporting information
outputs: actual dietary-history account with uncertainties and relevant circumstances

steps.what: Record the actual dietary history, source attribution, examples and uncertain or missing information
inputs: actual dietary-history account with uncertainties and relevant circumstances
checked dietary assessment context

steps.what: Evaluate the actual dietary history and other available information in the nutritional assessment within the technician's assigned scope
inputs: complete draft actual dietary history
checked dietary assessment context
outputs: technician-formed nutritional assessment and unresolved questions

steps.what: Write the programme-planning contribution from the assessment, with proposed priorities and questions for dietitian review
inputs: technician-formed nutritional assessment and unresolved questions
dietitian-issued assessment guidance and role boundary
outputs: complete nutritional assessment and programme-planning contribution

steps.what: Check the final history, assessment and planning contribution and approve their internal record version
inputs: complete nutritional assessment and programme-planning contribution
complete draft actual dietary history

steps.what: Save the approved history, assessment and planning contribution as one internal assessment record
inputs: approved assessment record packet v1
outputs: stored actual nutritional assessment and planning contribution

tasks.design: Configure an existing-information view and dietary-history form in the {OPS_SYSTEM}, reusing verified identity and existing reference fields. The technician conducts the history, records actual meaning, evaluates it and writes the programme-planning contribution before approving its record version.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reference lookup and repeated case metadata can add effort around obtaining and evaluating a dietary history.
tasks.enabler_now: Native forms can reuse known identity and reference fields without generating a patient's history or nutritional assessment.
tasks.still_hard: Recall, context, uncertainty and individual needs require careful questioning and assessment.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise when an apparently precise account is incomplete and ask a useful follow-up question.

ambition.what: No expanded clinical authority is assumed.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-5 for dietary records and care-team consultation about changed forms

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: structured care forms can reuse verified identity and existing references while people capture actual histories and assessments.

assumptions: Boundary includes obtaining and evaluating history and writing a nutritional programme-planning contribution under dietitian supervision. The technician's record approval does not authorise a clinical programme beyond the assigned scope; dietitian decision work is separate and receives no saving.

The care record supplies identity and dated existing information; the dietitian supplies guidance. s2 obtains the actual account and s3 retains twelve hours for substantive capture, attribution and uncertainty. No transcript, automatic diagnosis or freely structured conversation output is assumed.
Native configuration first. Prefill reuses only known case metadata; all assessment and programme-planning judgement stays fully retained. There is no automatic dietitian send or plan activation.
Shares and reductions are provisional scenarios, not measured baselines. Same-system saving remains fully retained; if native forms already reuse these fields, the gain is zero.
unknowns: Existing assessment form and permitted technician scope
research_questions: Does the history form preserve attributed and uncertain statements?
Does prefill reduce effort without changing assessment meaning?

already_counted.description: Capture and check the actual dietary history and uncertainty

incremental.description: Maintain dietary-history form references and fields

approvals.approved_version: approved assessment record packet v1 including exact history, assessment and contribution; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central gross 8 minus 0.5 upkeep gives 7.5. High allows 2.5 additional hours checking uncertain source references; low applies when existing native views and forms already cover the work.
